events.title: Kings vs. Minnesota Timberwolves
events.addr: 500 David J Stern Walk, Sacramento, CA 95814
events.blurb: The Sacramento Kings host the Minnesota Timberwolves on Sunday evening downtown.
events.blurbEs: Los Sacramento Kings reciben a los Minnesota Timberwolves el domingo por la tarde en el centro.

events.title: Theatre of Lights
events.addr: K Street, Old Sacramento, Sacramento, CA 95814
events.blurb: A free 20-minute outdoor show staged on the balconies above K Street, telling "A Visit from St. Nicholas" alongside 1850s pioneer stories. It opens this weekend and runs through Dec 24.
events.blurbEs: Un espectáculo gratuito al aire libre de 20 minutos en los balcones sobre K Street, que narra "A Visit from St. Nicholas" junto con historias de pioneros de la década de 1850. Se estrena este fin de semana y sigue hasta el 24 de diciembre.

events.title: Holidays on K Street
events.addr: K Street, Old Sacramento, Sacramento, CA 95814
events.blurb: Weekend afternoons in Old Sacramento with live music, family activities and a Letters to Santa station.
events.blurbEs: Tardes de fin de semana en Old Sacramento con música en vivo, actividades familiares y una estación de Cartas a Santa.

events.title: THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride
events.venue: Central Pacific Passenger Station (California State Railroad Museum)
events.blurb: A holiday train ride based on the classic book, departing from the Old Sacramento waterfront. Coach seats are $80–85 and First Class $100–110.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo navideño en tren basado en el libro clásico, que sale del malecón de Old Sacramento. Los asientos de clase turista cuestan $80–85 y los de primera clase $100–110.

events.title: Gimme Gimme Disco
events.blurb: An ABBA-inspired disco dance party in the upstairs room at Harlow's in Midtown.
events.blurbEs: Una fiesta de baile disco inspirada en ABBA en la sala de arriba de Harlow's, en Midtown.

events.title: Sacramento Central Farmers Market
events.blurb: The city's big year-round Sunday market under the freeway at 8th and W, with produce, baked goods and prepared food from regional farms.
events.blurbEs: El gran mercado dominical de la ciudad, abierto todo el año bajo la autopista en 8th y W, con productos frescos, panes y comida preparada de granjas de la región.

events.title: Between Earth and Sky: Contemporary Maya Paintings from Guatemala
events.blurb: An exhibition of contemporary paintings by Maya artists from Guatemala. Admission is $15 for adults, $8 for youth and free for ages 5 and under.
events.blurbEs: Una exposición de pinturas contemporáneas de artistas mayas de Guatemala. La entrada cuesta $15 para adultos, $8 para jóvenes y es gratis para menores de 5 años.

upcoming.title: The Nutcracker (Sacramento Ballet)
upcoming.venue: SAFE Credit Union Performing Arts Center
